eligibility_ruling.not_determined_by: the European Commission, or any Commission officer, adviser or funder
eligibility_ruling.call_text_basis: EIC Work Programme 2026 p. 33 (Pathfinder Challenges general conditions), p. 24 (SME and small mid-cap definitions), p. 176 + footnote 286 (Associated Countries), pp. 44-47 (DeepRAP Challenge chapter, which contains no eligibility carve-out)

single_applicant_route.basis: 'If the proposal is from one single legal entity, this entity must be established in a Member State or an Associated Country (unless stated otherwise in the specific Challenge chapter).' CSOAI LTD is established in the United Kingdom, an Associated Country for Horizon Europe Pillar III. The DeepRAP Challenge chapter states no carve-out, so the general conditions apply unchanged.
single_applicant_route.uk_role: Beneficiary, funded directly by the European Commission; not an Associated Partner
single_applicant_route.uk_guarantee_scheme: Not the route. The UK Horizon Europe Guarantee scheme covers 2021-2022-2023 work-programme calls; this is a 2026 work-programme call, covered by association.

rule.two_entities: two independent legal entities from two different Member States or Associated Countries
rule.three_or_more: at least one legal entity established in a Member State, and at least two other independent legal entities each established in a different Member State or Associated Country
rule.submission: submitted by the coordinator on behalf of the consortium

consortium_route.note: A consortium was an alternative route, not a precondition. Taking the single-applicant route meant no partner had to be found, named or signed.

mid_cap_restriction.rule: 'In the case of single beneficiary projects, mid-caps and larger companies will not be permitted.' (p. 33)

non_submission_reasons.reason: The Funding & Tenders Portal organisation registration and the PIC are human-held and cannot be created by an agent. The route to a PIC requires an EU Login, an organisation registration for CSOAI LTD, and the person in charge of that profile requesting the PIC from the Commission. As of this record neither the registration nor the PIC exists, so no submission vehicle existed.

Key-staff CVs and staff-effort budget arithmetic are human facts that are not present in the estate and must not be invented. No CV exists for any proposed key person, and the only rate model in the estate belongs to a different programme with every salary line marked 'OWNER TO CONFIRM'. Stating CV or rate facts the estate does not hold would be a false statement to the Commission.
Legal declarations must be signed by a human. The F&T legal declarations and the ethics, data-protection and conflict-of-interest declarations require a human signature, and none exists.

non_submission_characterisation.statement: The applicant-side facts - portal registration, PIC, CVs, effort-and-rate arithmetic, and signed declarations - could not be produced and signed by a human before 2026-10-28T16:00Z. This was a documented decision, not an oversight.
